cards.confidence.few_samples: - too few samples ({samples} < 5): this number is not stable, do not read it as a conclusion
cards.confidence.unknown: Confidence: no source to judge from (no number shown)
cards.confidence.source.none: Confidence source: none to judge from
cards.rollback.confirm.title: Confirm rollback
cards.rollback.confirm.body: This will attempt to undo the step. The receipt comes from the server and is never written as restored.
cards.rollback.irreversible: This step is marked irreversible, so the page offers no rollback.
cards.rollback.blocked: Rollback is blocked: dependent steps are still open.
cards.rollback.ref.missing: The original step is not in this list.
cards.rollback.offline: Offline preview: rollback needs the server, so the button is unavailable.
cards.rollback.plan.loading: Reading the rollback plan: the dependency closure, blockers and notices all come from the server.
cards.rollback.plan.failed: The rollback plan did not come back, so no rollback request is sent.
cards.rollback.plan.scope: This rollback covers {count} records (dependency closure included, target last)
cards.rollback.plan.deps.none: No later dependencies: only this step is rolled back.
cards.rollback.plan.order: Execution order (deepest first, target last): {count} records
cards.rollback.plan.confirm_needed: The plan requires a second confirmation: after you confirm, the request carries confirm_all=true.
cards.rollback.plan.truncated: Dependencies run deeper than the depth cap: {count} members are outside this scope (the dropped count is stated).
cards.rollback.plan.blockers: Blockers (one per reason, straight from the server)
cards.rollback.plan.blocked_stop: The plan is blocked: there is no executable undo path, so the page sends nothing.
cards.rollback.record.level: Record-level compensation: only the record-level effect inside this system is undone; content already generated or sent cannot be recalled.
cards.rollback.no_side_effect: This record has no tool action, so there is no external side effect to undo; the page offers no rollback.
cards.rollback.journal_unreadable: The undo journal cannot be read: the page closes the rollback entry and never claims the step is reversible.
cards.rollback.view_partial: Only the first {planned} rows of this batch were checked (cap {limit}); the rest are undecided, so the page never claims everything is reversible.
cards.rollback.blocked.note: Rollback is blocked: the read-time blocker details are below.
cards.rollback.blocked.irreversible: The server judged this step irreversible, so the page offers no rollback.
cards.rollback.blocked.already: The undo journal already holds a rollback for this step, so the page offers no rollback entry.
cards.rollback.blocked.no_effect: This step has no external side effect to undo, so the server refuses the rollback.
cards.rollback.kept_declared: This record's rollback state came from the source declaration (imported field); the page shows the source value and does not overwrite it with a product verdict.
cards.rollback.rolled.note: This step is inside the undo scope (the state is derived at read time, never stored).
cards.rollback.next.ref: Rollback compensation record for this step: {id}
cards.rollback.next.ref.aria: Go to the rollback compensation record for this step: {id}
cards.rollback.inverse.label: Inverse action: {op}
cards.rollback.receipt.label: Inverse receipt: {state}
cards.rollback.receipt.simulated_local: Local simulation: the inverse action is only recorded locally, no external system was called (never written as restored).
cards.rollback.receipt.executed_sandbox: Sandbox pilot: the inverse action really wrote inside the explicitly whitelisted sandbox root; the production system was not touched.
cards.rollback.receipt.executed_registry: The registry executor really ran the inverse action; no external receipt was reported.
cards.rollback.receipt.failed: The inverse action failed: no terminal success was recorded, check the undo journal.
cards.rollback.pilot.note: Sandbox pilot only means the real write happened inside the explicitly whitelisted sandbox root; the production system was not touched, and it is never phrased as the external system having undone the step.
cards.rollback.done.receipt: Rollback submitted; inverse receipt state: {state} (the receipt is the server's).
cards.rollback.timeline.rolled: Timeline: this step is rolled back
cards.rollback.timeline.ref: The dashed timeline link points at the original step this rollback undid: {id}
cards.rollback.error.rollback_not_reversible: The server judged this step irreversible (ROLLBACK_NOT_REVERSIBLE).
cards.rollback.error.rollback_already_rolled_b: This step was already rolled back (ROLLBACK_ALREADY_ROLLED_BACK).
cards.rollback.error.rollback_dependents_pendi: Dependent steps are not confirmed yet (ROLLBACK_DEPENDENTS_PENDING): confirm and retry with confirm_all.
cards.rollback.error.rollback_dependents_irrev: The dependency closure holds members that cannot be undone (ROLLBACK_DEPENDENTS_IRREVERSIBLE).
cards.rollback.error.rollback_journal_unreadab: The undo journal cannot be read (ROLLBACK_JOURNAL_UNREADABLE); the page does not claim the step is reversible.
cards.rollback.error.rollback_not_found: The action to roll back was not found (ROLLBACK_NOT_FOUND).
cards.rollback.error.rollback_field_invalid: The rollback request carries an invalid field (ROLLBACK_FIELD_INVALID).
cards.rollback.error.rollback_idempotency_mism: This idempotency key already belongs to another action_id (ROLLBACK_IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH).

cards.evidence.vote.offline: Offline preview: voting needs the server.
cards.evidence.vote.count.pending: Feedback landed; this response carried no counts. The ledger owns those numbers - they show after a refresh.

cards.evidence.screenshot.pending: Screenshot evidence is not wired yet: the runtime never captures screenshots automatically (D-7); an executor or the user has to upload one.

cards.causal.note.llm: This text was generated by a model and may contain inference: verbatim facts live in the evidence fingerprint and the ledger.
cards.causal.note.model_unknown: The record does not say who generated this text; the page does not guess.
